name: Warmth of Winter
source:
A visual novel, set in a small town, about the choices we make in life.


You are a fox in a small European village, interacting with the locals and trying to understand the world around you. 


From https://www.facebook.com/pages/Earthshine-Games/365725533592686
translation:
一部以小镇为背景的视觉小说，讲述我们在生活中所做的选择。


你是欧洲小村庄里的一只狐狸，与当地人互动并试图了解周围的世界。


来自https://www.facebook.com/pages/Earthshine-Games/365725533592686
